text_block_list.text:
I went to see Symboli Rudolf
to discuss our training plan, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing serious, just a slight headache.
It will pass if I rest for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I have a mountain of work
that must be finished before today ends.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Preparing materials for this week's budget meeting, reviewing equipment requisition forms, and so on...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get this over with quickly, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No... If not for this, it would've been done in no time,
but things rarely go as planned.

And so, Symboli Rudolf found herself
plagued by a headache...
